title: Transport Costs And Economic Distance
definition: Transport costs refer to the direct and indirect expenses incurred in moving goods, passengers, and information from origin to destination, while economic distance translates physical distance into cost, time, and effort metrics that dictate spatial interaction and market reach.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE GS Paper 1 (Human Geography, location of industries, world economic geography) and GS Paper 3 (Infrastructure, logistics, economic development, supply chain resilience).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Transport Costs And Economic Distance.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
